Subject: Re: Production spike — initial triage notes

Notes from triage call (09:00 PST):

Observed behavior:
- Short-lived traffic surge from Cartonix (peak +3.8x for 8 minutes).
- Initial failure mode: 429s from our rate limiter, quickly followed by 5xx (502/504) on the inference layer as backend connection queues filled.
- Client retry logic caused sticky hot paths: repeated identical prompt requests bypassed prefix cache (no cache-hit), causing repeated full-model invocations.

Root causes (probable):
1) Rate limiter configuration uses a per-tenant token bucket with a short refill window; under bursty client retry patterns it shot to 429 quickly rather than smoothing (alerting threshold tied to aggregate global rate, not per-route latency).
2) Autoscaling for Dedicated pools lagged for short, high-QPS spikes; queued requests hit internal connection pool limits leading to connection timeouts and 502s.
3) Missing alert for rapid increase in client retry rate (we have token-bucket breach alerts but not a dedicated retry/amplification signal).

Immediate mitigations applied (09:10–09:18 PST):
- Raised per-tenant soft throttle for Cartonix by 2x and bypassed aggressive client-specific bucket enforcement for 5 minutes.
- Expanded connection_pool_size on the inference side for the affected pool.
- Added temporary more-permissive fallback to a slightly higher-latency model variant (lower mem footprint) to reduce queue pressure.

Data artifacts attached: slo-delta-summary.csv, sample-error-logs.txt.

Follow-ups (owners & ETA):
- Add retry-amplification alert (dev_patel) — ETA 48h to add signal and tune thresholds.
- Review per-route rate limiter smoothing & add per-route latency correlation in alerts (jonas_weber) — ETA 7 days.
- Autoscale policy adjustment for short spikes and ability to burst (monica_patel infra) — ETA 10 days with canary policy.
- Update docs/runbook for immediate customer mitigation steps (grace_oconnor) — ETA 24h.

I'll open SUP-4928 to track the technical work.

— Dev
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

- Immediate mitigations removed majority of errors by 09:20 PST. No code rollouts from Redwood were responsible.
- Root cause: interaction of short burst traffic + conservative per-tenant throttle + autoscale lag + missing retry-amplification alert.
- Customer asks: (a) timeline for permanent mitigation, (b) a one-time goodwill credit for affected checkout sessions, (c) improved post-incident communication on RCA and runway to full mitigation.

Proposed exec actions:
1) Approve one-time credit (~$12k) for Cartonix (pending finance review).
2) Prioritize adding the retry-amplification alert and a runbook entry for customer mitigation steps in the next sprint (target: complete in 7 days).
3) Authorize temporary capacity reserve in us-west for peak-sensitive customers while autoscale policies are tuned (cost estimate in follow-up).

Are we aligned? If yes I'll send a short note to Cartonix with timelines and credit offer.

— Hannah

- 10 days: autoscale policy update to permit short micro-bursts and a canary rollout for Dedicated pools — owner: monica_patel.

Compensation: Hannah has proposed a goodwill credit; finance will finalize and we will share the number by 11/24 EOD.
